title: objectql aggregate positions miss two of `where`'s behaviours: `having` resolves no `{placeholder}` (`{ $gte: "{not_a_token}" }` answers 200 where `where` answers 400), and the per-aggregation `filter` temporal refusal names its path `where.…`
body:
Filing gate: **① defects with a named landing site**: `engine.aggregate` in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`. It is one class-closure card for two positions that lack a `where` behaviour:
- `having` never passes through `resolveWhereTokens`, which reads `ast.where` only;
- the per-aggregation `filter` calls `assertTemporalComparandsInterpretable` with no path, so its refusal roots at `where`.

Finding class **(a)**. `reach:` was measured at the public REST door on `main` (below).

The `domain:engine` execution seat 1 (`session_01Bvd69VPa6puiNzzPUroDBx`) filed this from its #20263 dev's report (`os-dev-report` 5859428680, `out_of_scope_findings[0..1]`), re-measured at the REST door by the at-tier review of PR #20307 (record 5860498332). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

Measured at `2dccb7d494`, which equals `main` on these paths; PR #20307 (`a78f731add`) moves none of these cells. The drivers are InMemoryDriver, SqlDriver on SQLite and SqlDriver on PostgreSQL 16, through `engine.aggregate` and REST `POST /api/v1/data/:object/query`, on both `having` paths.

| position | input | answer | its `where` twin |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `having` on `max(placed_on)` | `{ $gt: "{current_year_start}" }` | **200, keeps no group**, although every group's max day is in 2026 (the resolved bound keeps c1–c4) | the token resolves |
| `having` | `{ $gte: "{not_a_token}" }` | **200, keeps no group** | `FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN` / 400 "Unresolvable filter placeholder…" |
| `having` | `{today}` / `{30_days_ago}` | compared as literal text (c1–c4 / none) | resolved |
| `aggregations[1].filter` | `{ placed_on: { $gt: "not-a-date" } }` | `INVALID_FILTER` / 400, but the message says **`at where.placed_on.$gt`** | the same words at `where.placed_on.$gt` |

- On `having`, a relative-date token silently compares as text, and an unknown token keeps no group with a 200. That is the #8690 silent-200 shape, on the token axis.
- The per-aggregation refusal is right, but it points the author at a `where` they did not write.

## Suggested shape (⛔ not a ruling)

- Resolve `having`'s placeholders through the same resolver `where` uses, with the same `FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN` refusal. `having` already passes the temporal-comparand door since #20263, and that door steps around `{placeholder}` strings as `where`'s does.
- Pass `aggregations[i].filter` as the path to the per-aggregation temporal door, as the other per-aggregation doors already name it.
- Pin both on the three drivers and both doors, beside the `where` twin.

## Filing-gate answers

- **Class**: ① (defects with a named landing site), folded into one class-closure card (the aggregate positions' parity with `where`); finding class (a), measured.
- **Acting reader**: this lane's seat (`domain:engine`, the owner of `packages/objectql`).
- **Dedupe**, MCP semantic issue search in this repo, `closed` included:
  - `having placeholder token not resolved current_year_start FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN` → #8690 (the `where` door, closed), not this;
  - `aggregation filter refusal message path where instead of aggregations filter` → #20122, #20148, #10861 and the `?filter=` family (#8003, #8001, #8005, #7390, #4121), none this.

Dedupe words: `having placeholder token not resolved` · `having FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN missing` · `per-aggregation filter refusal path where`
